#### Methods

##### authorize()

```ts
authorize(
   authorization,
   context,
   evse?,
   connector?): Promise<
  | "Accepted"
  | "Blocked"
  | "ConcurrentTx"
  | "Expired"
  | "Invalid"
  | "NoCredit"
  | "NotAllowedTypeEVSE"
  | "NotAtThisLocation"
  | "NotAtThisTime"
| "Unknown">;
```

Defined in: [02_Util/src/authorizer/RealTimeAuthorizer.ts:59](https://github.com/citrineos/citrineos-core/blob/def27d2c18695e68d1cb53d23c8d4cfb26151d5f/02_Util/src/authorizer/RealTimeAuthorizer.ts#L59)

Interface for adding additional authorization logic.
If status is not Accepted, the authorization process will stop and the rejection put into the response.
The order of Authorizers can lead to different outputs; instantiate them in the order they should be called.
